name: Diana Harshbarger
bio: a Representative from Tennessee; born in Kingsport, Tenn., January 1, 1960; graduated from Ketron High School, Kingsport, Tenn., 1978; attended East Tennessee State University, Johnson City, Tenn.; Pharm.D, Mercer University, Atlanta, Ga., 1987; pharmacist; business owner; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2021-present).
